faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Mumbai Port Authority Specialist posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Mumbai Port Authority Specialist recruitment is 29th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Specialist post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Specialist post in the Mumbai Port Authority Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Specialist (Radiology) post?
faq.answer: For Specialist (Radiology), candidates need an M.B.B.S. degree with MS/DNB in Radiology or an M.B.B.S. with a Diploma in Radiology or equivalent.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Specialist posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Specialist posts is 50 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Specialist positions?
faq.answer: The salary for Specialist positions ranges from Rs. 1,45,000 to Rs. 1,60,000 per month, depending on the specialization.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Mumbai Port Authority Specialist recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The job is located in Mumbai, Maharashtra, with the pincode 400037.

faq.question: Q9. How should I send my application?
faq.answer: Applications should be sent via email, along with all required documents, before the last date.

faq.question: Q10. Does the Mumbai Port Authority offer age relaxation?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided for reserved category candidates in accordance with applicable Government guidelines.
